name: Paywall
summary: How to compose a plan-gated upsell — the shared Paywall popover's anatomy (crown badge + feature label, one-sentence value prop + unlock line, single Upgrade CTA), its props/copy/behaviour contract, and the PAYWALL_SHOWN / PAYWALL_UPGRADE_CLICKED analytics funnel — built from existing components.
lead: Every pro-gated affordance routes through ONE shared Paywall popover so the editor, share, results and dashboard surfaces feel like a single product — and so monetisation expands by evolving this one component plus the upgrade URL, never by hand-rolling another upsell. This pattern ships NO new component: it composes an overlay (popover), a crown badge, an Icon and a Button, and documents the CONVENTIONS the repo can enforce. The narrative 'why', worked examples and judge verdicts live in the aha-design-paywall / -judge skills; this artifact carries the enforceable ruleset the DS now owns.

skillRef.note: The DS now owns this build ruleset as the single source of truth; the plugin skill is generated FROM this artifact. Rationale, BAD/GOOD examples and the PASS/FAIL judge evals stay in the skill — each rule below traces back by ref to the skill's PAYWALL-xx assertions (or the section that states it).

rules.rule: Route every pro-gated affordance through the shared Paywall component — never hand-roll an upgrade modal, tooltip, or popover for monetisation. Wrap the gated affordance in <Paywall>, or use <PaywallCrownBadge> as the anchor when the feature has no natural anchor of its own.

A paywall popover is always three stacked parts, top to bottom: header (crown badge + feature label), body (one-sentence value prop, then the unlock line), footer (single Upgrade CTA). No secondary 'View plans' button, no dismiss link, no multi-paragraph body.
The header glyph is the purple circular custom CrownBadge SVG (16×16) — never the generic Phosphor Crown, which lacks the circular background.
The feature label is a short noun phrase naming the locked feature, shown next to the crown — not a sentence.
The body is exactly one sentence describing the BENEFIT of unlocking (not 'This is a Pro feature.'), ending with a period.
The unlock line uses the fixed format 'Unlock with the <Plan> plan.' with the plan name bold — do not reword it.
The footer is a single full-width (block) primary Upgrade CTA — no secondary button inside the popover. Label is 'Upgrade' by default (a verb); override via ctaLabel only with a clear reason.
featureKey is a stable snake_case token (e.g. custom_survey_url), required, reused across analytics and DOM hooks.
requiredPlan is one of essential|pro (defaults to pro) and drives BOTH the unlock line and the analytics plan prop.
featureKey, featureLabel and body are all required props; placement defaults to 'top' and trigger defaults to 'click' (or 'hover').
PAYWALL_SHOWN fires when the popover opens, with props { feature: featureKey, plan: requiredPlan }.

PAYWALL_UPGRADE_CLICKED fires when the CTA is clicked — with the same { feature, plan } props — BEFORE navigation or onUpgrade runs. Never gate a feature without both events; they are the upsell funnel's denominator and conversion.
The default CTA opens UPGRADE_URL (https://ahaslides.com/pricing) in a new tab with noopener,noreferrer, then closes the popover.
When onUpgrade is provided it runs INSTEAD of opening the pricing page (e.g. an in-app upgrade modal); analytics still fires first and the popover still closes.
The anchor is wrapped in a <span> so children don't need to forward refs.
The popover surface is dark indigo (color #242442), 300px wide, 16px padding, 12px radius.
When a feature has no natural clickable anchor, use <PaywallCrownBadge> as the visible anchor — it carries role=img and an aria-label (default 'Upgrade required').

reuseNote: Doc-only pattern — ships no composition wrapper from this repo. The canonical composition lives in features/paywall (Paywall.tsx, CrownBadge, PaywallCrownBadge), mirroring the Presentation app's UpgradePopover so the two products feel like one. The popover/placement mechanics are owned by aha-design-overlays. If the Paywall wrapper or the CrownBadge graduate into this DS, add a reuse block (and a real lib/ entry) and they are gated like a composite / leaf.

header = custom CrownBadge + short feature label (not Phosphor Crown)
body one sentence ending in a period + fixed 'Unlock with the <Plan> plan.' line
single block Upgrade CTA, no secondary button
PAYWALL_SHOWN on open, PAYWALL_UPGRADE_CLICKED before nav, both { feature, plan }
